name: Cohabitation ~Oshikake Nyoubou wa Onee-san!?~
original_name: Cohabitation ～押しかけ女房はお姉さん！？～
source:
The beautiful secretly admired neighbor moves into main character's apartment. One long hot summer day begins this way under loud hearth throbbing.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公暗中仰慕的美丽邻家姐姐搬进了他的公寓。一个炎热而漫长的夏日，就在震耳欲聋的心跳声中拉开序幕。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vndb-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
